en.text: “Most certainly, I tell you, one who doesn’ t enter by the door into the sheep fold, but climbs up some other way, is a thief and a robber.

zhSimplified.text: 「我实实在在地告诉你们，人进羊圈，不从门进去，倒从别处爬进去，那人就是贼，就是强盗。

zhTraditional.text: 「我實實在在地告訴你們，人進羊圈，不從門進去，倒從別處爬進去，那人就是賊，就是強盜。

en.text: Butone who enters in by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.

zhSimplified.text: 从门进去的，才是羊的牧人。

zhTraditional.text: 從門進去的，才是羊的牧人。

en.text: Thegatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.

zhSimplified.text: 看门的就给他开门；羊也听他的声音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊领出来。

zhTraditional.text: 看門的就給他開門；羊也聽他的聲音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊領出來。

en.text: Wheneverhe brings out his own sheep, he goes before them; and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.

zhSimplified.text: 既放出自己的羊来，就在前头走，羊也跟着他，因为认得他的声音。

zhTraditional.text: 既放出自己的羊來，就在前頭走，羊也跟着他，因為認得他的聲音。

en.text: Theywill by no means follow a stranger, but will flee from him; for they don’ t know the voice of strangers.”

zhSimplified.text: 羊不跟着生人；因为不认得他的声音，必要逃跑。」

zhTraditional.text: 羊不跟着生人；因為不認得他的聲音， 必要逃跑。」

en.text: Jesus spoke this parable to them, but they didn’t understand what he was telling them.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣将这比喻告诉他们，但他们不明白所说的是什么意思。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌將這比喻告訴他們，但他們不明白所說的是甚麼意思。

en.text: Jesus therefore said to them again, “Most certainly, Itell you, I am the sheep’s door.

zhSimplified.text: 所以，耶稣又对他们说：「我实实在在地告诉你们，我就是羊的门。

zhTraditional.text: 所以，耶穌又對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，我就是羊的門。

en.text: Allwho came before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep didn’ t listen to them.

zhSimplified.text: 凡在我以先来的都是贼，是强盗；羊却不听他们。

zhTraditional.text: 凡在我以先來的都是賊，是強盜；羊卻不聽他們。

en.text: Iam the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out and will find pasture.

zhSimplified.text: 我就是门；凡从我进来的，必然得救，并且出入得草吃。

zhTraditional.text: 我就是門；凡從我進來的，必然得救，並且出入得草吃。

en.text: Thethief only comes to steal, kill, and destroy. I came that they may have life, and may have it abundantly.

zhSimplified.text: 盗贼来，无非要偷窃，杀害，毁坏；我来了，是要叫羊得生命，并且得的更丰盛。

zhTraditional.text: 盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊得生命，並且得的更豐盛。

en.text: “Iam the good shepherd. Thegood shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.

zhSimplified.text: 我是好牧人；好牧人为羊舍命。

zhTraditional.text: 我是好牧人；好牧人為羊捨命。

en.text: Hewho is a hired hand, and not a shepherd, who doesn’ t own the sheep, sees the wolf coming, leaves the sheep, and flees. The wolf snatches the sheep and scatters them.

zhSimplified.text: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看见狼来，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，赶散了羊群。

zhTraditional.text: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看見狼來，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，趕散了羊群。

en.text: Thehired hand flees because he is a hired hand and doesn’ t care for the sheep.

zhSimplified.text: 雇工逃走，因他是雇工，并不顾念羊。

zhTraditional.text: 雇工逃走，因他是雇工，並不顧念羊。

en.text: Iam the good shepherd. I know my own, and I’m known by my own;

zhSimplified.text: 我是好牧人；我认识我的羊，我的羊也认识我，

zhTraditional.text: 我是好牧人；我認識我的羊，我的羊也認識我，

en.text: evenas the Father knows me, and I know the Father. I lay down my life for the sheep.

zhSimplified.text: 正如父认识我，我也认识父一样；并且我为羊舍命。

zhTraditional.text: 正如父認識我，我也認識父一樣；並且我為羊捨命。

en.text: Ihave other sheep which are not of this fold. Imust bring them also, and they will hear my voice. They will become one flock with one shepherd.

zhSimplified.text: 我另外有羊，不是这圈里的；我必须领他们来，他们也要听我的声音，并且要合成一群，归一个牧人了。

zhTraditional.text: 我另外有羊，不是這圈裏的；我必須領他們來，他們也要聽我的聲音，並且要合成一群，歸一個牧人了。

en.text: Thereforethe Father loves me, because I lay down my life, thatI may take it again.

zhSimplified.text: 我父爱我；因我将命舍去，好再取回来。

zhTraditional.text: 我父愛我；因我將命捨去，好再取回來。

en.text: Noone takes it away from me, but I lay it down by myself. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again. I received this commandment from my Father.”

zhSimplified.text: 没有人夺我的命去，是我自己舍的。我有权柄舍了，也有权柄取回来。这是我从我父所受的命令。」

zhTraditional.text: 沒有人奪我的命去，是我自己捨的。我有權柄捨了，也有權柄取回來。這是我從我父所受的命令。」

en.text: Therefore a division arose again among the Jews because of these words.

zhSimplified.text: 犹太人为这些话又起了纷争。

zhTraditional.text: 猶太人為這些話又起了紛爭。

en.text: Many of them said, “He has a demon and is insane! Why do you listen to him?”

zhSimplified.text: 内中有好些人说：「他是被鬼附着，而且疯了，为什么听他呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 內中有好些人說：「他是被鬼附着，而且瘋了，為甚麼聽他呢？」

en.text: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one possessed by a demon. It isn’t possible for a demon to open the eyes of the blind, is it?”

zhSimplified.text: 又有人说：「这不是鬼附之人所说的话。鬼岂能叫瞎子的眼睛开了呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 又有人說：「這不是鬼附之人所說的話。鬼豈能叫瞎子的眼睛開了呢？」

en.text: It was the Feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem.

footnotes.text: 10:22 The “Feast of the Dedication” is the Greek name for “Hanukkah”, a celebration of the rededication of the Temple.

zhSimplified.text: 在耶路撒冷有修殿节，是冬天的时候。

zhTraditional.text: 在耶路撒冷有修殿節，是冬天的時候。

en.text: It was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in Solomon’s porch.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣在殿里所罗门的廊下行走。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌在殿裏所羅門的廊下行走。

en.text: The Jews therefore came around him and said to him, “How long will you hold us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”

zhSimplified.text: 犹太人围着他，说：「你叫我们犹疑不定到几时呢？你若是基督，就明明地告诉我们。」

zhTraditional.text: 猶太人圍着他，說：「你叫我們猶疑不定到幾時呢？你若是基督，就明明地告訴我們。」

en.text: Jesus answered them, “Itold you, and you don’ t believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, these testify about me.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣回答说：「我已经告诉你们，你们不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以为我作见证；

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌回答說：「我已經告訴你們，你們不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以為我作見證；

en.text: Butyou don’ t believe, because you are not of my sheep, as I told you.

zhSimplified.text: 只是你们不信，因为你们不是我的羊。

zhTraditional.text: 只是你們不信，因為你們不是我的羊。

en.text: Mysheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me.

zhSimplified.text: 我的羊听我的声音，我也认识他们，他们也跟着我。

zhTraditional.text: 我的羊聽我的聲音，我也認識他們，他們也跟着我。

en.text: Igive eternal life to them. They will never perish, and no one will snatch them out of my hand.

zhSimplified.text: 我又赐给他们永生；他们永不灭亡，谁也不能从我手里把他们夺去。

zhTraditional.text: 我又賜給他們永生；他們永不滅亡，誰也不能從我手裏把他們奪去。

en.text: MyFather who has given them to me is greater than all. No one is able to snatch them out of my Father’s hand.

zhSimplified.text: 我父把羊赐给我，他比万有都大，谁也不能从我父手里把他们夺去。

zhTraditional.text: 我父把羊賜給我，他比萬有都大，誰也不能從我父手裏把他們奪去。

en.text: Iand the Father are one.”

zhSimplified.text: 我与父原为一。」

zhTraditional.text: 我與父原為一。」

en.text: Therefore the Jews took up stones again to stone him.

zhSimplified.text: 犹太人又拿起石头来要打他。

zhTraditional.text: 猶太人又拿起石頭來要打他。

en.text: Jesus answered them, “Ihave shown you many good works from my Father. For which of those works do you stone me?”

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣对他们说：「我从父显出许多善事给你们看，你们是为哪一件拿石头打我呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌對他們說：「我從父顯出許多善事給你們看，你們是為哪一件拿石頭打我呢？」

en.text: The Jews answered him, “We don’t stone you for a good work, but for blasphemy, because you, being a man, make yourself God.”

zhSimplified.text: 犹太人回答说：「我们不是为善事拿石头打你，是为你说僭妄的话；又为你是个人，反将自己当作 神。」

zhTraditional.text: 猶太人回答說：「我們不是為善事拿石頭打你，是為你說僭妄的話；又為你是個人，反將自己當作上帝。」

en.text: Jesus answered them, “Isn’tit written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣说：「你们的律法上岂不是写着『我曾说你们是神』吗？

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌說：「你們的律法上豈不是寫着『我曾說你們是神』嗎？

en.text: Ifhe called them gods, to whom the word of God came (and the Scripture can’t be broken),

zhSimplified.text: 经上的话是不能废的；若那些承受 神道的人尚且称为神，

zhTraditional.text: 經上的話是不能廢的；若那些承受上帝道的人尚且稱為神，

en.text: doyou say of him whom the Father sanctified and sent into the world, ‘You blaspheme,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?

zhSimplified.text: 父所分别为圣、又差到世间来的，他自称是 神的儿子，你们还向他说『你说僭妄的话』吗？

zhTraditional.text: 父所分別為聖、又差到世間來的，他自稱是上帝的兒子，你們還向他說『你說僭妄的話』嗎？

en.text: IfI don’ t do the works of my Father, don’t believe me.

zhSimplified.text: 我若不行我父的事，你们就不必信我；

zhTraditional.text: 我若不行我父的事，你們就不必信我；

en.text: Butif I do them, though you don’ t believe me, believe the works, that you may know and believe that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”

zhSimplified.text: 我若行了，你们纵然不信我，也当信这些事，叫你们又知道又明白父在我里面，我也在父里面。」

zhTraditional.text: 我若行了，你們縱然不信我，也當信這些事，叫你們又知道又明白父在我裏面，我也在父裏面。」

en.text: They sought again to seize him, and he went out of their hand.

zhSimplified.text: 他们又要拿他，他却逃出他们的手走了。

zhTraditional.text: 他們又要拿他，他卻逃出他們的手走了。

en.text: He went away again beyond the Jordan into the place where John was baptizing at first, and he stayed there.

zhSimplified.text: 耶稣又往约旦河外去，到了约翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那里。

zhTraditional.text: 耶穌又往約旦河外去，到了約翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那裏。

en.text: Many came to him. They said, “John indeed did no sign, but everything that John said about this man is true.”

zhSimplified.text: 有许多人来到他那里。他们说：「约翰一件神迹没有行过，但约翰指着这人所说的一切话都是真的。」

zhTraditional.text: 有許多人來到他那裏。他們說：「約翰一件神蹟沒有行過，但約翰指着這人所說的一切話都是真的。」

en.text: Many believed in him there.

zhSimplified.text: 在那里，信耶稣的人就多了。

zhTraditional.text: 在那裏，信耶穌的人就多了。
